	final String medName;
	final String shortName;
	final int[] itemIDs;

	BetterItemIdentification(Type type, String medName, String shortName, int... ids)
	{
		this.type = type;
		this.medName = medName;
		this.shortName = shortName;
		this.itemIDs = ids;
	}

	private static final Map<Integer, BetterItemIdentification> itemIdentifications;

	static
	{
		ImmutableMap.Builder<Integer, BetterItemIdentification> builder = new ImmutableMap.Builder<>();

		for (BetterItemIdentification i : values())
		{
			for (int id : i.itemIDs)
			{
				builder.put(id, i);
			}
		}

		itemIdentifications = builder.build();
	}

	static BetterItemIdentification get(int id)
	{
		return itemIdentifications.get(id);
	}
